item.title: Woman who admitted to falsely accusing Duke lacrosse players of rape released from prison
item.description: DURHAM, N.C. (WNCN) – Crystal Mangum, the woman who falsely accused three members of the Duke University men's lacrosse team of rape in 2006, was released from prison on Friday. Mangum, a former exotic dancer, has been incarcerated at the North Carolina Correctional Institution for Women in Raleigh since her 2013 conviction for second-degree murder [...]

item.title: Durham area drug manufacturing plants hit with layoffs, more than 150 workers impacted, state report shows
item.description: According to the WARN report, the MERK location at 100 Rodolphe St. will layoff 7 people, with the 5325 Old Oxford Rd. location laying off 147 people. The layoffs will go into effect May 1.

item.title: Victim in deadly Raleigh stabbing revealed affair with suspect before murder: Warrants
item.description: Search warrants in the deadly stabbing of a man in Raleigh last October show a possible motive for the suspect.

item.title: Victim, suspect in deadly Durham pizzeria shooting were both employees: Documents
item.description: The victim and suspect in a deadly shooting at a pizzeria in Durham Thursday afternoon were both employees of the restaurant, documents show.

item.title: Lyft driver charged with murder in crash that killed Durham teacher, husband in Detroit: Officials
item.description: A Durham teacher and her husband are dead after their Lyft driver crashed into a warehouse in Detroit last weekend, officials said Thursday.

item.title: 'Hazardous materials' disposed of on North Duke Street in Durham, fire department says
item.description: The Durham Fire Department's Hazardous Materials Team got called into action Friday evening.

item.title: Warm March start won’t last long for central NC
item.description: A cold front that moved through overnight will facilitate an area of low pressure riding along the front that will allow another batch of rain Friday.

item.title: Durham neighbors react to mother charged with murder and attempted murder
item.description: Neighbors are reacting to the case of a Durham Mother charged with murder and attempted murder after police found her two children unresponsive in their Durham home on Chartwell Court.

item.title: Candidate for Johnston County commissioner charged with crashing into school bus, leaving scene: Warrant
item.description: A candidate for the Johnston County Board of Commissioners is facing charges in connection with a crash involving a school bus Thursday, a warrant shows.
